div.head: VIII Atr 31.1
div.ab: ⁊ heonan forð we willað, þæt abbodas ⁊ munecas regollicor libban, þonne hi nu ær ðisan on gewunan hæfdon.
⁊ heonan forð we willað þæt abbodas ⁊ munecas regollicor libban þonne hi nu ær ðisan on gewunan hæfdon.
And heonan forð we willað, þæt abbodas and munecas regollicor libban, þonne hi nu ær ðisan on gewunan hæfdon.
Und wir wollen hinfort, dass Äbte und Mönche mehr nach kanonischer Regel leben, als sie bis jetzt vordem gewöhnlich pflegten.
And henceforth we will that abbots and monks live more according to the rule than they have been accustomed to until now.
And henceforth we desire abbots and monks to live more according to a rule than they have been accustomed to do until now.
And henceforth we desire that abbots and monks live more in accordance with the rule than they have been in the habit of doing up till now.
And we order abbots and monks to live henceforth more in accordance with their rule than they have been wont to do previously.
